dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, serrated 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings with sharp gradient transitions from a dark charcoal base to off-white perimeters, primarily localized along the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity punctate flecks and asymmetrical clusters lacking internal gradients, interspersed between larger annular structures and increasing in concentration toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with a secondary linear chain of smaller blobs extending ventrally from the central-most ring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent localized orange-red high-intensity pixel cluster in the ocular/aural region, indicative of a camera-induced ocular reflection or artificial tag.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense, reticulated mesh-like texture at the posterior extremity where individual annular structures merge into a continuous high-contrast lattice.
